Not reachable: the ReDoS needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern such as +(*). Every picomatch or micromatch caller here is build, dev, test or deploy tooling whose patterns come from repository config: Expo CLI, Metro config, expo-doctor and resolve-workspace-root; React Native codegen and SPM scripts; Vite, Vitest, tsx, tinyglobby and fdir; jest-util; the shadcn CLI via dotenvx; and the CI-only alchemy deploy CLI. No app, Worker or admin source imports a glob library, and the native runtime packages do not require one. Next.js vendors its own picomatch, but `next build` compiles the image patterns from developer config into fixed regex strings, so requests supply only the URL being matched. The apps/web Worker bundle contains no picomatch. No fixed release exists yet (4.0.7 is the latest); remove this exception once a patched picomatch is published and the lockfile resolves it.
